Title: Successful login with standard_user
Steps:
1. Enter "standard_user" into Username field.
2. Enter "secret_sauce" into Password field.
3. Click "Login" button.
Expected Result: User is redirected to /inventory.html and product list is displayed.

Title: Attempt login with locked_out_user
Steps:
1. Enter "locked_out_user".
2. Enter "secret_sauce".
3. Click "Login".
Expected Result: Error message displayed: "Epic sadface: Sorry
Execution Type: this user has been locked out."

Title: Attempt login with empty fields
Steps:
1. Leave Username and Password empty.
2. Click "Login".
Expected Result: Error message displayed: "Epic sadface: Username is required"

Title: Attempt login with invalid password
Steps:
1. Enter "standard_user".
2. Enter "wrong_password".
3. Click "Login".
Expected Result: Error message displayed: "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service"

Title: Sort products by Name (A to Z)
Steps:
1. Click sort dropdown.
2. Select "Name (A to Z)".
Expected Result: Products display in alphabetical order from A to Z.

Title: Sort products by Name (Z to A)
Steps:
1. Click sort dropdown.
2. Select "Name (Z to A)".
Expected Result: Products display in reverse alphabetical order from Z to A.

Title: Sort products by Price (low to high)
Steps:
1. Click sort dropdown.
2. Select "Price (low to high)".
Expected Result: First product price is $7.99 and last product price is $49.99.

Title: Sort products by Price (high to low)
Steps:
1. Click sort dropdown.
2. Select "Price (high to low)".
Expected Result: First product price is $49.99 and last product price is $7.99.

Title: Add item to cart from inventory page
Steps: 1. Click "Add to cart" on Sauce Labs Backpack.
Expected Result: Button changes to "Remove" and shopping cart badge updates to "1".

Title: Remove item from cart on inventory page
Steps: 1. Click "Remove" on Sauce Labs Backpack.
Expected Result: Button changes to "Add to cart" and shopping cart badge disappears.

Title: Navigate to product detail page
Steps: 1. Click "Sauce Labs Backpack" title.
Expected Result: User redirected to /inventory-item.html?id=4 showing product details and price $29.99.

Title: Add item to cart from detail page
Preconditions: Logged in on product detail page
Steps: 1. Click "Add to cart" button.
Expected Result: Button changes to "Remove" and shopping cart badge updates to "1".

Title: Navigate back to products list
Preconditions: Logged in on product detail page
Steps: 1. Click "Back to products" button.
Expected Result: User redirected back to /inventory.html.

Title: Verify cart items and total count
Steps: 1. Click shopping cart icon.
Expected Result: User redirected to /cart.html showing both selected items.

Title: Remove item from cart page
Steps: 1. On /cart.html click "Remove" next to an item.
Expected Result: Item is removed from list and cart badge updates to "1".

Title: Continue shopping from cart
Steps: 1. Click "Continue Shopping" button.
Expected Result: User redirected back to /inventory.html.

Title: Complete checkout with valid inputs
Steps:
1. Open cart and click "Checkout".
2. Enter First Name "John"
Expected Result: Last Name "Doe"
column8: Order completed showing "Thank you for your order!" message.

Title: Checkout validation - missing First Name
Steps:
1. Leave First Name empty.
2. Enter Last Name and Zip.
3. Click "Continue".
Expected Result: Error message displayed: "Error: First Name is required"

Title: Checkout validation - missing Zip/Postal Code
Steps:
1. Enter First Name and Last Name.
2. Leave Zip empty.
3. Click "Continue".
Expected Result: Error message displayed: "Error: Postal Code is required"

Title: Verify checkout price calculation
Steps: 1. Proceed to /checkout-step-two.html.
Expected Result: Item total shows $29.99

Title: Logout from side menu
Steps:
1. Click burger menu icon.
2. Click "Logout" link.
Expected Result: User session ends and user is redirected to login page (/).

Title: Reset App State
Steps:
1. Click burger menu icon.
2. Click "Reset App State".
Expected Result: Cart badge is cleared and all button states reset to "Add to cart".

Title: Direct navigation to protected URL without login
Steps:
1. Open browser.
2. Navigate directly to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html.
Expected Result: Access is denied and user is redirected to / with error message.
